details:
A filesystem browser for Cockpit

Security Fix(es):

* cockpit-files: cockpit-files: Arbitrary file ownership and permission modification via symlink race condition (CVE-2026-91203)

* cockpit-files: cockpit-files: Arbitrary file ownership change via symlink following in privileged paste (CVE-2026-91202)

* cockpit-files: cockpit-files: Local attacker can hijack file ownership via symlink race (CVE-2026-91205)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
